recipe.text:
Shakshuka with feta

Ingredients
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, finely chopped
1 red bell pepper, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika
2 tins (400 g) chopped tomatoes
6 eggs
100 g feta, crumbled
Salt and black pepper, to taste
A handful of fresh coriander

Preparation
1. Chop the onion and dice the pepper.
2. Mince the garlic and measure out the spices.
3. Crumble the feta and pick the coriander leaves.

Method
1. Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and fry the onion and pepper until soft.
2. Stir in the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for a minute.
3. Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for ten minutes until thick.
4. Make six wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
5. Cover and cook until the whites are set.
6. Scatter over the feta and coriander and serve from the pan.
